Implemented the contact form in [ContactForm.tsx](/workspace/app/ContactForm.tsx). It has labeled name, email, and message fields, plus an inline server action that rejects missing or whitespace-only values and logs validated submissions.

The project has no persistence layer for contact messages, so the action currently logs the submission. I didn’t run tests. I left the unrelated `package.json` change and untracked `package-lock.json` untouched.
